conformism.definitionKo: 서로 다른 것을 인정하지 않고 모두를 일정한 기준에 따라 똑같이 만들려고 하는 경향.
conformism.englishDescription: A tendency of making everything the same according to a certain standard, without recognizing differences.

depression.definitionKo: 상품의 생산과 소비의 균형이 깨져 실업률이 높아지고 화폐의 가치가 떨어져 물가 상승이 극심해지는 어려운 경제 상황.
depression.englishDescription: A difficult economic situation in which the unemployment rate increases, the value of the currency falls and prices increase due to the imbalance of the production and consumption of a product.

depression.definitionKo: 걱정 등으로 마음이 답답하여 활발한 기운이 없는 감정.
depression.englishDescription: A feeling of lack of energy due to feeling frustrated due to worries, etc.

depression.definitionKo: 사회의 경제 활동이 활발하지 않아, 물가와 임금이 내리고 생산이 줄어들며 실업이 늘어나는 상태.
depression.englishDescription: A state in which prices and wages fall, production decreases, and unemployment increases as economic activity is depressed.

depression.definitionKo: 걱정 등으로 마음이 답답하여 활발한 기운이 없음.
depression.englishDescription: The state of feeling low and frustrated due to worries, etc.
The state of losing one's confidence and energy.

depression.definitionKo: 기분이나 분위기가 매우 좋지 않은 상태.
depression.englishDescription: The state of being very depressed or in a very bad mood.
The state of one's mood or the atmosphere, etc., sinking.

depression.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 사물 등이 발전하지 못하고 제자리에 머무름.
depression.englishDescription: The state of a certain project, object, etc., not developing and staying where it is.

depression.definitionKo: 일정한 힘을 받아 표면이 안쪽으로 움푹 들어감.
depression.englishDescription: The surface of an object being depressed by a certain force.

depression.definitionKo: 어떤 현상이나 사물이 발전하지 못하고 제자리에 머물러 있는 시기.
depression.englishDescription: A period in which a phenomenon or object does not develop and stays where it is.

disinfection.definitionKo: 병에 걸리는 것을 막기 위해 약품이나 열 등으로 균을 죽임.
disinfection.englishDescription: The act of destroying germs with chemicals, heat, etc., in order to prevent one's getting sick.

gradation.definitionKo: 자, 저울, 온도계 등에 수나 양을 표시하려고 그어 놓은 금.
gradation.englishDescription: Lines drawn on a ruler, scale, thermometer, etc., to indicate the quantity or amount of something.

hyeonchung-il.definitionKo: 나라를 위하여 목숨을 바친 군인과 경찰 등을 기리기 위해 정한 기념일. 6월 6일이다.
hyeonchung-il.englishDescription: Memorial  Day: A day designated in Korea to commemorate the soldiers and police officers, etc., who died for their country; it falls on June 6.

instructive.englishDescription: Being helpful or instructive to a behavior.

june.definitionKo: 일 년 열두 달 가운데 여섯째 달.
june.englishDescription: The sixth month of a year, out of twelve months.

precise.definitionKo: 빈틈이나 잘못이 전혀 없을 만큼 엄격하고 세밀하다.
precise.englishDescription: Being strict and minute without any loopholes or errors.
Exactly right and being free of falsehood.

precise.definitionKo: 아주 정확하고 꼼꼼하여 빈틈이 없고 자세하다.
precise.englishDescription: Extremely accurate, meticulous, flawless and detailed.
Very appropriate and exactly right in reality.

sickly.englishDescription: In the state of suffering chronically from poor health.

sickly.definitionKo: 병 때문에 몸이 약하다. 또는 몸이 약해서 병에 잘 걸리는 상태이다.
sickly.englishDescription: Weak due to an illness; being more likely to get sick because one is weak.

tenancy.definitionKo: 일정한 구역에 업체나 가게, 시설 등이 들어감.
tenancy.englishDescription: The act of an enterprise, store, facility, etc., occupying a certain area.

ttarogukbap.definitionKo: 밥을 국에 말지 않고 국과 밥을 서로 다른 그릇에 담아 내는 국밥.
ttarogukbap.englishExpression: ttarogukbap; rice and soup; rice and soup served separately
ttarogukbap.englishDescription: Gukbab, rice soup, rice and soup served in separate bowls, not in one big bowl.

worm.definitionKo: 곤충이나 기생충 등 몸 구조가 간단한 동물.
worm.englishDescription: An animal whose body has a simple structure, such as an insect or parasite.

yahoo.definitionKo: 사람들이 산에 오르면서 서로 부르거나 외치는 소리.
yahoo.englishDescription: A sigh called out when climbing a mountain.
